summary: A light SaaS hero on #fafafa. A white centred column (x 116–1136, hairline grey border) holds the top half. The side gutters (x 0–116 and 1136–1252, y 0–370) are filled with fine vertical grey hairline stripes. A nav bar at the top: serif wordmark "Boomtax" at the left, grey sans links "Features / Pricing / Our Story / Contact", and at the right "Log in" and "Book a Demo", split by a hairline divider. A hairline rule runs under the nav at y≈42. The headline "E-File Your Tax / Forms in Seconds." is a near-black (#04131a) high-contrast serif, about 58 px, on two centred lines (y 95–205). Under it sits a two-line grey sans subhead, then two 46 px tall square-cornered buttons: solid #0196fb "Try Boomtax Free" with white text, and a white bordered "Book a Demo". Below the column, a full-width strip (y 422–494) has six hairline-divided cells of grey monochrome partner logos: FreshBooks, intuit quickbooks, an Excel mark, xero, zoho and a PDF file icon. The bottom (y 494–894) is an isometric line illustration on the same striped ground. An input conveyor runs from the top-left down-right into a white Boomtax machine (black rounded "b" badge, green arrow glows, a green status dot, a lime-green glowing mouth). It carries white iso tiles with coloured file icons (grey, red PDF, blue DOC, black, green XLS, blue). An output conveyor leaves the machine down-right carrying blue tiles with green checks. Around it float static props on thin grey wire paths: a grey file tile, a green sheet tile, a paper stack, a mail station with a blue screen, a blue check tablet, and an upload station with a yellow bolt. The only motion is the two belts. Every tile slides down-right along its belt with an eased, pulsing advance of about 40–60 px in x (about 0.57 px of y per px of x) per ~1.5 s, nearly pausing around 1.9–2.4 s. A tile entering the mouth goes green in the glow and comes out as a blue check tile. The page text, logos, props and the machine stay still.

criteria.check: The page ground is a flat off-white near #fafafa, not pure white and not tinted
The left gutter (x 0–116, y 0–370) is filled with fine vertical grey hairline stripes a few px apart, the same as the right gutter x 1136–1252
The stripes are thin 1px vertical lines, not a solid grey band and not a dot or diagonal pattern
A light-bordered centre column spans x≈116 to 1136 and ends at y≈422
Top-left wordmark reads "Boomtax" in a dark serif, starting at x≈133
Nav links read "Features", "Pricing", "Our Story", "Contact" left to right in grey sans
Right of the nav reads "Log in" then "Book a Demo", with a vertical hairline divider between them at x≈1028
A hairline grey rule runs under the nav at y≈42
Headline reads exactly "E-File Your Tax" on line 1 and "Forms in Seconds." on line 2
Headline is a high-contrast serif in near-black (#04131a), about 58px cap-to-descender, not a sans
Headline is horizontally centred on x≈626, spanning x≈381–871, line 1 top at y≈100
Subhead reads "Upload your data and let Boomtax handle everything from" / "filing to mailing with total accuracy and compliance." on two centred lines
Subhead is mid-grey sans about 16px, clearly lighter than the headline
Primary button is solid bright blue #0196fb with square (≤2px) corners, about 149x46px
Primary button reads "Try Boomtax Free" in white medium sans
Secondary button is white with a 1px light grey border, same height as the primary, about 10px to its right
Secondary button reads "Book a Demo" in dark sans
A full-width logo strip sits at y≈422–494, split into six cells by vertical hairlines at x≈203, 414, 625, 836, 1047
Logos left to right are FreshBooks, intuit quickbooks, an Excel mark, xero, zoho, a PDF file icon
All partner logos are light grey monochrome, none in brand colour
Logos are drawn as simple grey vector marks with recognisable silhouettes (F badge + wordmark, qb circle + wordmark, X grid, xero lowercase, zoho linked boxes, folded PDF page)
Below the logo strip an isometric illustration fills y≈494–894 on the same vertical-stripe ground
The illustration is flat iso line art: white extruded blocks with thin grey outlines and soft grey side faces, no photographic texture
The input belt runs diagonally from the top-left (x≈195, y≈494) down-right into the machine's left face (x≈530, y≈680)
Belt tiles are white rounded iso squares, each carrying one coloured file icon: grey, red PDF, blue DOC, black, green XLS, blue
About six file tiles are visible on the input belt, evenly spaced about 55px apart in x
The machine block sits at x≈527–697, y≈615–767, where the two belts meet
Machine top carries a black rounded-square badge with a white lowercase "b", green glowing arrow marks above and below it, and a small green dot at the right corner
The machine mouth on its right face glows lime/yellow-green with a soft blurred halo spilling outside the opening, not a hard-edged green rectangle
Output belt tiles are white iso squares with a blue form icon and a green check mark
The output belt leaves the machine mouth and runs down-right off the bottom edge near x≈990, y≈894
A white iso base with a grey envelope and an upright blue screen sits at x≈691–809, y≈508–616
A blue upright iso tablet with a green check floats at x≈810–862, y≈655–735, with a dotted grey line under it
A white iso base with a yellow lightning bolt and an upright blue round screen sits at x≈427–544, y≈745–853
A stack of white paper sheets with a blue icon on top sits at x≈313–370, y≈645–707
A loose grey file tile floats at x≈186–242, y≈545–580, and a green sheet tile at x≈541–598, y≈540–574, off the belt
Thin grey 1px zigzag wire lines link the machine to the mail station and the upload station
The red PDF tile moves down-right along the belt, from about (370,560) to about (432,594): about 62px right and 34px down
The belt barely advances between 1.9s and 2.4s (under 10px), then moves clearly between 2.4s and 2.95s (about 30px in x)
Output check tiles move down-right in step with the input belt, the same direction and a similar distance
The tile in the machine mouth shows green inside the glow, and blue check tiles appear beyond it as the belt advances
Headline, subhead, buttons, nav and logo strip do not move or change
The mail station, check tablet, upload station, paper stack, floating tiles and machine body stay in place
Tiles glide smoothly with eased speed changes, never jump a slot in a single frame
New file tiles keep entering from the top-left edge, so the belt is never empty during the clip
